subject: A shared warning leaves {{reportRecipient}} without an assurance

locus.descriptor: the secure briefing room where the receipt and report are read together

opening.text: {{reportRecipient}} has the warning. The share record proves delivery, not a request for help. The finding says: {{reportFinding}}
The source is {{reportSource}}; confidence is {{reportConfidence}}. The gaps remain {{reportGaps}}. A new tasking might narrow them, but it has no result tonight.
An arms transfer would be immediate support for the government touched by the reported pursuit. It would also commit us before they have asked.

replies.text: Transfer arms to {{reportRecipient}} now, before its government asks for support.
Task another assessment of the reported pursuit before committing material support.

commitment.remembered: The President tasked further collection against the report target before committing material support to the recipient.

rejoinder.text: The new tasking is recorded. It supplies no new finding tonight, so the recipient must plan with the warning it already has.

collection.question: What further reporting bears on the pursuit named in this warning?

replies.text: Send a relief shipment to {{reportRecipient}} now, without treating the shared warning as a request for aid.

context.standing: The administration shared an issued warning with {{reportRecipient}}. The delivery is recorded. No answer or request for assistance appears in that record.
context.precedent: A government that shares a warning may later be asked what it meant to offer. A bounded offer can help a partner plan without promising a larger commitment.

pressures.want: The Secretary of State wants the recipient to know whether this administration will actually transfer support now.
The intelligence community wants another collection effort before the warning becomes a wider claim.

context.inaction: The recipient has the warning, but this administration sends no support or fresh tasking while its government weighs what to do.
context.unknown: The share record does not say whether the recipient has corroborating evidence or wants our help.
